text:
Priya: Quick clarification from the all-hands: what happens when a customer exhausts monthly credits but still has daily rate-cap headroom? Are requests allowed until the day resets?

Carlos: Credits and rate caps are separate. If monthly credits are exhausted, calls are rejected (billing limit) even if rate cap allows more traffic. Rate caps only throttle traffic within active credit/invoice coverage.

Priya: Is there any soft-fail path we offer (e.g., send a lightweight 1-token reply) to keep integrations alive?

Sam (CEO): Not by default. We do have an opt-in fallback policy for some accounts that routes to a compact model with strict token limits to reduce cost. That's configured at account level in Console today.

eng-ops-bot: Heads up: new header we're rolling out next week: `X-Credit-Remaining` which will show token-equivalent credits left.

Carlos: Also note that billing auto-recharge resumes access instantly once payment clears; webhooks/invoice events are emitted.

Priya: Great, can we get the `X-Credit-Remaining` header documented in the API reference before rollout?

Sam (CEO): Yes, action: @Carlos to add header docs and a short KB explaining credit vs quota vs rate-cap behavior.

Priya: Thanks — will share customer questions to include in the KB.
